Wealthy Family.name: Wealthy Family
Wealthy Family.description:
💴 Your family has money: a company, property or an old name.

🎓 You grew up with tutors, formal dinners and an allowance.
⚠️ Expectations come with the money.

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Etiquette +5, Business +5
🎒 Starts with: ¥100,000
Wealthy Family.traitNarrativeEffects: Wealthy family; the player may set the source (company, hospital group, property, support-gear maker, old money), else a large private company; original, never canon. Money: the starting yen is a one-time allowance; more comes only through the story (a conditional gift, a request, a favor owed), never as monthly income. It buys gear, travel, private clinics, good lawyers; never U.A. admission, grades, a hero license, rankings or loyalty, as the narrator shows. Pressure: inheritance, marriage and career expectations; classmates who think they bought their place; flatterers; reporters; villains eyeing a ransom. Scandal hurts the business, so the family fights a villain or vigilante path and can cut them off. Quirkless: the family paid every specialist and second opinion before accepting the diagnosis. Childhood: tutors, elite schools, business dinners, formal manners, household staff, a planned future; at ease at galas, quick to spot those who want something.
